_comment: Tech Kit roles (Settings > Role). Allow/Deny match 'Category\Script name', 'Script name' or the file path, with * wildcards. Roles only limit what this Tech Kit shows and runs; scripts always run with the signed-in account's own rights. RequireTicket asks for a ticket or reason before any change. RequireApproval makes a second person sign in (member of Approval.ApproverGroup) before any change. Everything is recorded in Logs\audit.csv.

Senior Tech.Description: Everything, but every change needs a ticket number or reason.

Helpdesk.Description: Look-ups and everyday fixes. Changes need a ticket. No terminal, no script editing, no offboarding.

Changes need approval.Description: Everything, but each change needs a ticket and a second person from the approver group.

Read-only auditor.Description: Reports and look-ups only. Scripts that make changes are hidden.
